Hi Sam,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited to get BrightEdge set up as an approved supplier. Before we kick off the SOW/PO flows, a couple of practical questions on invoice delivery and PO acknowledgement so we can wire this into our AP intake: 

Quick context: Redwood prefers an automated acknowledgement (so vendors get a receipt and PO match status) and ideally a structured invoice payload we can ingest programmatically. We support: hosted vendor portal (preferred for structured ingestion), SFTP drop, or a dedicated vendor email to invoices@redwood.com with a subject token. We can also emit a webhook acknowledgement if your system can receive one.

Questions for your intake team (short answers are fine):
- Can you send invoices via an SFTP or only email?
- Do you support inserting our PO number in an invoice header field or subject token (PO: 12345)?
- Are you able to receive an HTTP acknowledgement webhook (we POST a status back: received / accepted / needs-info)?

Attached: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf — please fill, sign, and return. If you prefer, we can also collect the same fields inline here.

If portal integration is not possible on day one, we’ll accept emailed invoices with the following constraints (so our AR/AP mapping is deterministic):
- Send to invoices@redwood.com
- Subject contains: PO|InvoiceNumber|Company (e.g., PO12345|INV-2027-004|BrightEdge)
- Attachments: PDF invoice (no ZIPs) or a CSV for batched lines
- Include the PO number on the invoice PDF in a clearly labeled field

I'll let Marissa and Karthik weigh in on match rules. If this works, can you return the onboarding form by EOD next Tue?

Thanks,

Tessa Morgan
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi Tessa,

Thanks — great to hear. Quick answers from our side: 
- We can do email and SFTP drops today; we do not have a hosted portal to push invoices into Redwood.
- We can include the PO number in the invoice body and filename, and we can also insert it into an invoice header if you can accept a structured MIME header or a specific subject token.
- We do not consume HTTP webhooks natively, but our billing platform can send an acknowledgement email back to a configured address (we can also trigger a simple webhook via a lightweight integration if needed; would need technical contact).

We filled out the onboarding PDF partially — will finish and return by Monday. A couple of clarifying questions for Redwood to speed this up: 
1) If we email invoices, do you require a single invoice per email or can we send batched invoices as one CSV?
2) For PO stamping: do you want us to embed the PO number in the filename and in the invoice header, or is filename alone sufficient?

Sample reply so you have our tech contact: Sam Ortega, Ops Lead, sam.ortega@brightedge.com.

Best,

Tessa / Karthik — quick internal summary and suggestion for BrightEdge based on Sam's reply: 

Summary:
- BrightEdge can do email and SFTP. No portal.
- They can add PO to filename and invoice header. They can send acknowledgement email but webhook is optional (they can build if we provide a simple spec).

Recommended onboarding/acceptance pattern (min friction, deterministic for our AP):
1) Day 0: Accept invoices via invoices@redwood.com. Require subject token and searchable filename: PO{PO_NUM}|INV{INum}|VendorName (e.g., PO12345|INV-2027-004|BrightEdge).
2) Require a single invoice PDF per email OR a CSV when they're submitting batched monthly invoices (we will parse CSVs with a standard schema — see sample-invoice.csv attached).
3) We will run automatic PO match against PO number in subject/filename/header. If match found and amounts reconcile, AP auto-accepts and an acknowledgement email is sent back to ops@brightedge.com with a unique acknowledgement token (ACK-<8 char>).
4) If match fails, AP routes to manual review and the vendor receives a rejection email with the failure reason and a request for corrected invoice.

Decision points for procurement:
- Do we want to require the onboarding form to be returned before the first invoice? My lean: yes, to ensure remittance and tax info are captured.
- PO stamping: require both filename and visible header field (reduces OCR misses).

Attached is a sample-invoice.csv with the schema we want (line-level items, qty, unit_price, tax). If BrightEdge can't produce CSVs, PDFs are fine but expect occasional manual work.

If we agree, Tessa can send a short email to Sam with the final requirements and the Doc/Drive link to our onboarding form.

Marissa
Head of Supplier Operations
Redwood Inference

Hi Sam — thanks for the quick answers and for offering your tech contact. To keep go-live tight, here is our agreed path: 

1) Send the completed vendor_onboarding_form.pdf back to me (Karthik) and Tessa before your first invoice. Drive link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1OnboardFormXyZ
2) Day 0 integration: we will accept emailed invoices to invoices@redwood.com. Please use this subject pattern exactly: PO{PO_NUM}|{INVOICE_NO}|{VENDOR_NAME}
3) Filename should also include PO number (e.g., PO12345_INV-2027-004.pdf).
4) For batched submissions, you may attach a CSV that follows the sample schema (sample-invoice.csv). We prefer a single invoice per message for faster acknowledgement.
5) On our side, AP will emit an acknowledgement email within 2 business hours containing ACK token and a link to the invoice record. If you prefer webhook instead, Sam please confirm and we will provide a lightweight spec (SUP-221).
6) Policy: invoices older than 90 days from invoice date will be auto-rejected (we'll notify and provide rejection reason).

If BrightEdge can provision a webhook endpoint (URL + HMAC secret) we can accelerate the two-way status flow; otherwise the emailed ACK is acceptable for now. Please return the onboarding PDF by Monday and CC procure@brightedge.com.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you live.

Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Strategic Ops
Redwood Inference
